title: 第21章 既分高下也决生死凌雪瑶冰第22章啾啾啾废物来我先让你三招
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
凌雪瑶冰雪聪明，转眼间便想到绝妙之策。
她轻灵的嗓音在广场上突然响起，墨尘居和陆成原本离去的身影陡然停了下来。
陆成望向凌雪瑶，此刻在这等信任危机的局面下，所有人均不再信他，不知她又如何破局？
墨尘居看向凌雪瑶，深呼吸一口气，道：“说说看，你有何良策？”
人群顿时安静了下来，所有人松了一口气，纷纷看向凌雪瑶，若是凌雪瑶今日有办法，能让陆成以真实手段认证一品炼丹师，结果无论成功或是失败，那是陆成自己能力的问题。
最主要的是墨尘居，不会因为此事动怒而停止向宗门弟子炼丹！
毕竟在大家眼里，陆成认证一品炼丹师的这个事情与墨尘居从今往后是否向大家炼丹的事情相比，实在是太轻微了！
凌雪瑶美眸看向陆成，然后微微转身看向众人，语气轻柔道：“诸位长老，师兄师姐，小女子认为，今日大家来此的目的，是来见证陆成认证一品炼丹师，可这个过程却出现了意外，让大家对陆成接下来能否以真实能力认证一品炼丹师产生质疑，我有一良策，既可以判断陆成炼丹能力的真实性，又能消除大家心里的质疑，如何？”
这时，王厉开口道：“圣女有良策，那最好了！”说着，他目光看向墨尘居，道：“若是圣女的良策让大家满意，那你这弟子最后无法炼出极品筑基丹，墨大师可否收回方才的向宗门停止炼丹之语？”
王厉一句话便问出了大家心中最关心的问题，所有人纷纷目光转向墨尘居，眼神充满紧张，静等他的回答。
墨尘居目光扫过众人，冷哼一声道：“圣女若能自证老夫弟子清白，那弟子接下来成功与否，老夫都会收回那句话！”
听到墨尘居的保证，凌雪瑶微弯的纤眉也是舒展开来。
众人也是纷纷松了一口气。
但有几人例外，王飞宇便是其中之一。
王飞宇双手微微紧握，他好不容易再次阻止陆成继续认证一品炼丹师，这都要即将大获全胜了，却没想到圣女凌雪瑶却再次峰回路转，他准备向前一步再次开口，他爷爷王厉却突然转身，狠狠地瞪了他一眼，他只能选择放弃，站在原地，气的发抖！
另一侧的何念慈和吴长风，以及他们身后的二品炼丹师的弟子，则是脸色极其难看，陆成失败与否，与他们无关，最关键是他们从今往后在青玄宗内的信任度，在今日彻底跌入深渊，他们往日的行径，今日被扒得干干净净，若是凌雪瑶的计策真能证明陆成的清白，那墨尘居也将收回那句话，以他们此刻的名声，今日之后恐怕会彻底传遍整个宗门，届时，谁会再来找他们炼丹？
不自主地，何念慈和吴长风等人看向陆成的眼神，变了，充满了无尽敌意和不善！
陆成自然也感受到这股敌意，被十几人冰冷的目光直勾勾盯着，且那目光充满敌意和寒光，纵是心中再平静，他也能想到原因。
他目光看向何念慈和吴长风等人，嘴角微微勾起，这几个人，方才和王飞宇，合起伙来，推波助澜，为了自己的利益，真是好狠的手段！
他会将今日几人的嘴脸牢记心中，仙路漫长，迟早有一天他会狠狠地还回去！

并且他相信，这一天不会很远！
他望着何念慈等人，嘴角微微露出一丝淡淡的微笑，但这个笑容在何念慈和吴长风等人看起来，则是属于挑衅了！
陆成收回目光，看向凌雪瑶，静等凌雪瑶的良策。
凌雪瑶美眸看向众人，同时她自然也感受到何念慈和吴长风等人对陆成的敌意目光，她顺着目光看过去，待看到陆成那平静的神色中突然出现笑容时，美眸内也是闪过一丝惊讶，没来由的，她多看了陆成两眼，这个来自杂役峰的杂役，在众人面前始终面不改色，目光平静，在何念慈等人的敌意下，他竟然还露出那挑衅的笑容？
除去挑衅不谈，在这个局面下，陆成表现得实在是太过于镇定了，这份心性在很多筑基修士中都是很少具备的。
他到底有何依仗？
content_en:
Ling Xueyao was very smart and came up with a brilliant plan in the blink of an eye.
Her light voice suddenly sounded in the square, and the departing figures of Mo Chenju and Lu Cheng suddenly stopped.
Lu Cheng looked at Ling Xueyao. In this crisis of trust situation, no one believed in him anymore. How could she break the situation?
Mo Chenju looked at Ling Xueyao, took a deep breath, and said, "Tell me, do you have any good ideas?"
The crowd suddenly became quiet. Everyone breathed a sigh of relief and looked at Ling Xueyao. If Ling Xueyao could find a way today to make Lu Cheng certify a first-level alchemist by real means, whether the result would be success or failure would be a matter of Lu Cheng's own ability.
The most important thing is that Mo Chenju will not stop refining elixirs from the disciples of the sect because of this incident!
After all, in everyone's eyes, the matter of Lu Cheng's certification as a first-grade alchemist is too minor compared to the matter of whether Mo Chenju will make alchemy for everyone from now on!
Ling Xueyao looked at Lu Cheng with her beautiful eyes, then turned slightly to look at everyone, and said in a soft tone: "Elders, brothers, sisters, and little lady, I think the purpose of everyone coming here today is to witness Lu Cheng's certification as a first-grade alchemist. However, something unexpected happened during this process, which made everyone doubt whether Lu Cheng can certify as a first-grade alchemist with his true ability. I have a good idea, which can not only judge the authenticity of Lu Cheng's alchemy ability, but also eliminate the doubts in everyone's mind. How about it?"
At this time, Wang Li said: "The saint has a good plan, that's the best!" As he said, he looked at Mo Chenju and said: "If the saint's good plan satisfies everyone, then you, the disciple, will not be able to refine the best foundation-building pill in the end. Can Master Mo take back his words to stop refining pills to the sect?"
Wang Li asked the question that everyone was most concerned about in one sentence. Everyone turned to Mo Chenju with nervous eyes, waiting for his answer.
Mo Chenju glanced at everyone and snorted coldly: "If the saint can prove my disciple's innocence, then whether the disciple succeeds or not, I will take back those words!"
After hearing Mo Chenju's assurance, Ling Xueyao's slightly curved eyebrows also relaxed.
Everyone also breathed a sigh of relief.
But there are a few exceptions, and Wang Feiyu is one of them.
Wang Feiyu clenched his hands slightly. He finally stopped Lu Cheng from continuing to certify a first-grade alchemist. He was about to win a great victory, but he did not expect that Saint Ling Xueyao would turn around again. He was about to take a step forward and speak again, but his grandfather Wang Li suddenly turned around and glared at him fiercely. He could only choose to give up and stood there, shaking with anger!
On the other side, He Nianci and Wu Changfeng, as well as the disciples of the second-grade alchemist behind them, looked extremely ugly. Whether Lu Cheng failed or not had nothing to do with them. The most important thing was that their trust in Qingxuan Sect from now on had completely fallen into the abyss today. Ri's deeds were exposed today. If Ling Xueyao's plan can really prove Lu Cheng's innocence, then Mo Chenju will also take back his words. With their reputation at the moment, it will probably spread throughout the entire sect after today. Who will come to them to make alchemy again?
Involuntarily, the eyes of He Nianci, Wu Changfeng and others looking at Lu Cheng changed, full of endless hostility and unkindness!
Lu Cheng naturally felt this hostility. He was stared directly at by a dozen people with cold eyes, and the eyes were full of hostility and cold light. No matter how calm his heart was, he could still think of the reason.
He looked at He Nianci, Wu Changfeng and others, and raised the corners of his mouth slightly. These people, together with Wang Feiyu, had just joined forces to add fuel to the flames. They were really ruthless for their own benefit!
He will keep the faces of these people today in his heart. The road to immortality is long, and sooner or later he will return it harshly!
And he believes that this day will not be far away!
He looked at He Nianci and others with a faint smile on his lips, but this smile was not visible to He Nianci, Wu Changfeng and others.It seems like a provocation!
Lu Cheng withdrew his gaze and looked at Ling Xueyao, waiting for Ling Xueyao's good plan.
Ling Xueyao looked at everyone with her beautiful eyes. At the same time, she naturally felt the hostile looks from He Nianci, Wu Changfeng and others towards Lu Cheng. She followed their gazes and looked over. When she saw a sudden smile on Lu Cheng's calm expression, her beautiful eyes also flashed. A little surprised, for no reason, she glanced at Lu Cheng twice. This handyman from the handyman peak always had an unchanging expression and calm eyes in front of everyone. Under the hostility of He Nianci and others, he still showed that provocative smile?
Apart from the provocation, Lu Cheng was too calm in this situation. This kind of character is rarely possessed by many foundation-building monks.
What does he have to rely on?
